meta.name: agent-orchestration-advisor
meta.description: Design multi-agent AI workflows with clear boundaries, handoffs, and monitoring. Use when a complex PM task should run as parallel specialized agents instead of one linear process.

copy.tagline: 设计多智能体协作流程，明确边界与交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中协调多个AI智能体分工合作
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent workflows with clear boundaries and handoffs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple AI agents in a project

howto.what: Claude 会通过提问收集你的任务、耗时与工具背景，判断是否适合编排；然后把任务拆成多个专职智能体，设计并行/串行流程、边界、交接和人工审核点，并涉及监控与风险，最后输出多智能体协作方案。
howto.when: 当你说要设计多智能体工作流，或提到想用并行智能体替代线性流程、每周有 5 小时以上重复 PM 任务时触发。

say.text: 为我们的每周竞品情报设计一个编排：现在一个 PM 花 6 小时顺序做。
say.note: Claude 会先询问背景并逐步拆解任务。

say.text: 帮我重新架构那条顺序执行的 AI 工作流，改成并行多智能体系统。
say.note: 会分析依赖关系，设计并行与交接点。

say.text: 我每周花大量时间做客户反馈汇总，帮我设计并行智能体。
say.note: 会评估是否适合编排并给出分工方案。

howto.what_en: Claude will ask about your task and assess fit, then break it into specialized agents, design parallel/sequential flows with boundaries, handoffs, human review, and monitoring. Outputs a multi-agent plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design a multi-agent workflow, or mention replacing a linear process with parallel agents, or describe weekly repetitive PM tasks taking 5+ hours.

say_en.text: Design orchestration for weekly competitive intel, now sequential 6 hours.
say_en.note: Claude will ask background and break down the task.

say_en.text: Re-architect this sequential AI workflow into parallel multi-agent system.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze dependency and design handoffs.

say_en.text: Design parallel agents for our weekly customer feedback synthesis.
say_en.note: Claude will assess fit and propose agent breakdown.
